verdicts.question: Is the cable routing in the site photos continuous and consistent across the documented run - from rooftop panels to DCDB to inverter to ACDB to solar meter to main panel - with no orphan ends, no unexplained mid-run size changes, and visible conduit / cable-tie / clipping where the run is exposed?

Page 11 (Cable Routing): Shows PV module area with a note about making a hole to pass AC cable through the parapet - start of AC cable run from roof. Page 12 (Cable Routing continued): Shows the terrace room where Enphase accessories (IQ8P micro-inverters and IQ Gateway) will be installed - these function as the inverter/ACDB equivalent. Pages 13-14 (Meter Box): Show the main meter panel with annotated Main Meter and Solar Meter locations - end point of the AC cable. Page 16: Shows vertical interior cable routing down the building wall. Page 17 (Earthing Routing): Shows earthing cable run from existing earth pits. The DC cable run (panel to micro-inverter) is not separately documented since this is an Enphase micro-inverter system (DC-AC conversion happens at each panel). The full run segments documented are: panels to hole through parapet to Enphase accessories room to vertical wall run to main meter panel. No solar DCDB/ACDB box is separately shown (Enphase IQ8P architecture does not use a separate DCDB). No unexplained cable size changes or orphan ends are visible. However, the segment from the Enphase gateway output to the main panel via the lower floors is only partially documented.
verdicts.rationale: The cable routing is documented at key nodes (PV area, Enphase room, main meter panel) and the overall path is traceable. However, the mid-building vertical run (floors 1-3) is only partially shown in page 16, and the solar meter cubicle is annotated but not yet installed (building under construction). Full end-to-end continuity of the cable run with clipping/conduit visible at every exposed segment is not confirmed. Manual review recommended once cabling is installed.
